Rajya Sabha Expunges Finance Minister's Remarks on Communist Movement

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's remarks describing the Communist movement as 'total cowards' and of 'Communist style' were expunged from the Rajya Sabha records. CPI MP Sandosh Kumar had requested the expunction, calling the remarks a 'slur' and not a rebuttal. The remarks were made during a discussion in the Upper House.
